'''menace64 Utimate Bounty Hunter Deck, without an objective!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[menace64]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Interrogation Room|SE-D-cloudcityinterrogationroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Interrogation Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Cloud City Interrogation Room me.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

this deck has many bounty hunters with somewhat low deploy costs, so you can get them out really fast!

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

I have a lot of repeat cards, so that way if one is lost, i still have another. It makes the game much more difficult for your opponent when he kills a card then you whip another one out!
